title: A Practical Quantum Solver for Multidimensional Partial Differential Equations
problem: Solving multidimensional PDEs with low accuracy and high execution time on quantum devices
motivation: VQA-based quantum PDE solvers suffer from low accuracy, scalability issues on both simulators and real quantum hardware; classical methods don't leverage quantum advantages
method: Two algorithm variants: (1) FDM+C2Q+numerical instantiation, (2) FDM+C2Q+column-by-column decomposition for enhanced accuracy and scalability
key_novelty: Efficient quantum PDE solver outperforming VQA approaches on simulators and real quantum hardware; demonstrates scalability improvements
contributions: Novel quantum algorithm variants for PDE solving
Demonstrated on Poisson, heat, Black-Scholes, Navier-Stokes equations
Results on both noise-free/noisy IBM simulators and real hardware
limitations: Validation limited to specific PDE types; NISQ hardware constraints
